name: Retsujou Aijou 03
source:
After devastating his last victim he came across Akemi in the winding park paths. 
Yamamoto's eyes glinted deviously......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120171.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在摧毁了最后一个受害者后，他在蜿蜒的公园小路上遇到了明美。
山本的眼神闪烁着狡黠的光芒……
